When the commit threshold is not reached and no force flag is set, no statement in this call sets LS-RETURN-CODE (it keeps whatever value the caller passed). Same for FUNC-STAT. Recorded as found, not interpreted

program_narrative: Program DB2CMT is a called (subprogram) DB2 commit controller. The caller passes LS-COMMIT-REQUEST, whose 4-character function code selects one action per call: INIT clears the commit statistics, CMIT issues a DB2 COMMIT WORK only when the records-processed count has reached the commit frequency or a forced commit is requested, RBAK issues ROLLBACK WORK, SAVE creates a named savepoint, REST rolls back to a named savepoint, and STAT displays the commit, rollback and savepoint counters. After every SQL statement the program checks SQLCODE: on success it increments the matching counter and sets return code 0; on failure it copies SQLCODE and a message into LS-ERROR-INFO, sets return code 8 and calls DB2ERR. An unknown function code sets ERR-TEXT, return code 12 and calls ERRPROC. Control returns to the caller with GOBACK.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
pseudocode: -- Main dispatcher: route the caller's request by function code (LS-FUNCTION)
IF function code is 'INIT' THEN  -- FUNC-INIT
ELSE IF function code is 'CMIT' THEN  -- FUNC-CMIT
ELSE IF function code is 'RBAK' THEN  -- FUNC-RBACK
ELSE IF function code is 'SAVE' THEN  -- FUNC-SAVE
ELSE IF function code is 'REST' THEN  -- FUNC-REST
ELSE IF function code is 'STAT' THEN  -- FUNC-STAT
paragraphs.pseudocode_text:
-- Main dispatcher: route the caller's request by function code (LS-FUNCTION)
IF function code is 'INIT' THEN  -- FUNC-INIT
  CALL 1000-initialize
ELSE IF function code is 'CMIT' THEN  -- FUNC-CMIT
  CALL 2000-commit
ELSE IF function code is 'RBAK' THEN  -- FUNC-RBACK
  CALL 3000-rollback
ELSE IF function code is 'SAVE' THEN  -- FUNC-SAVE
  CALL 4000-savepoint
ELSE IF function code is 'REST' THEN  -- FUNC-REST
  CALL 5000-restore
ELSE IF function code is 'STAT' THEN  -- FUNC-STAT
  CALL 6000-statistics
ELSE
  SET err_text = 'Invalid function code'
  CALL 9000-error-routine
END IF
RETURN to caller  -- GOBACK

annotations.note: EVALUATE TRUE over 88-level names of LS-FUNCTION: first matching WHEN wins, so it is translated as an IF / ELSE IF chain
ERR-TEXT belongs to ERR-MESSAGE in copybook ERRHAND, which is passed to ERRPROC by 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
pseudocode: -- Reset the commit statistics for a new run
CLEAR ws_commit_stats  -- INITIALIZE: commit, rollback and savepoint counters set to zero
paragraphs.pseudocode_text:
-- Reset the commit statistics for a new run
CLEAR ws_commit_stats  -- INITIALIZE: commit, rollback and savepoint counters set to zero
SET ls_return_code = 0

paragraphs.name: 2000-COMMIT
pseudocode: -- Commit only when the commit threshold is reached or a commit is forced
IF ls_records_proc >= ls_commit_freq OR force-commit flag = 'Y' THEN  -- LS-FORCE-COMMIT
paragraphs.pseudocode_text:
-- Commit only when the commit threshold is reached or a commit is forced
IF ls_records_proc >= ls_commit_freq OR force-commit flag = 'Y' THEN  -- LS-FORCE-COMMIT
  CALL 2100-issue-commit
END IF

annotations.note: No ELSE: when the threshold is not reached nothing is done and LS-RETURN-CODE is not set in this call

paragraphs.name: 2100-ISSUE-COMMIT
pseudocode: -- Issue a DB2 commit and report the result to the caller
SQL COMMIT WORK  -- make all database changes of the current unit of work permanent
paragraphs.pseudocode_text:
-- Issue a DB2 commit and report the result to the caller
SQL COMMIT WORK  -- make all database changes of the current unit of work permanent
CHECK SQLCODE
IF sqlcode = 0 THEN
  INCREMENT ws_commit_count BY 1
  SET ls_return_code = 0
ELSE
  SET ls_sqlcode = sqlcode
  SET ls_error_msg = 'Commit failed'
  SET ls_return_code = 8
  CALL 9100-log-error
END IF

paragraphs.name: 4000-SAVEPOINT
pseudocode: -- Create a named DB2 savepoint supplied by the caller
SQL SAVEPOINT named ws_savepoint_id ON ROLLBACK RETAIN CURSORS  -- open cursors stay open if later rolled back to this point
paragraphs.pseudocode_text:
-- Create a named DB2 savepoint supplied by the caller
SET ws_savepoint_id = ls_savepoint_name
SQL SAVEPOINT named ws_savepoint_id ON ROLLBACK RETAIN CURSORS  -- open cursors stay open if later rolled back to this point
CHECK SQLCODE
IF sqlcode = 0 THEN
  INCREMENT ws_savepoint_count BY 1
  SET ls_return_code = 0
ELSE
  SET ls_sqlcode = sqlcode

  SET ls_return_code = 8

END IF

annotations.note: Savepoint name is a runtime value taken from the caller (host variable :WS-SAVEPOINT-ID)

paragraphs.name: 5000-RESTORE
pseudocode: -- Roll back to a named savepoint supplied by the caller
SQL ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT named ws_savepoint_id  -- undo changes made after that savepoint
INCREMENT ws_rollback_count BY 1  -- savepoint restores are counted as rollbacks
